## What's changed

- Kept paired Tater Tube Player sessions visible in Active Streams for the full viewing session, even after mpv has buffered the remaining media and the server-side transfer has finished.
- Preserved one activity card per player while retaining its direct-play, transcoding, hardware acceleration, and resolution details. Playback presence clears on stop or completion and expires safely if a player disconnects.
- Marked movies and episodes complete in the final 5% of playback, bounded between 30 seconds and five minutes, so titles leave Continue Watching when the viewer exits during credits.
- Continued completed television shows at the next episode, including across season boundaries, until the final episode has been watched.
- Kept the player heartbeat additive so existing and retro Tater Tube clients continue using their current playback behavior.
